title: El Sombrero de Sahuayo, MEXI TV
comment: sombrero-sahuayo (MEXITV): local de sombreros tejidos bajo el portal de la plaza de Sahuayo, Michoacán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ISIDRO_GODINEZ: Mexican man from Michoacán, hat weaver, 70 years old, thin, brown wrinkled skin, short white hair, a white mustache, a light-blue long-sleeve shirt, a brown leather apron, beige trousers, sandals, his hands empty.
chars.CLARA_GODINEZ: Mexican woman from Michoacán, 28 years old, light-brown skin, long wavy brown hair, a white embroidered blouse, a denim skirt, brown sandals, her hands empty.
chars.JOAQUIN_VALENCIA: Mexican man, 32 years old, light skin, slicked-back black hair, a thin goatee, a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, a gold chain, dark jeans, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.HONORIO_RUELAS: Mexican rancher boss from Michoacán, 72 years old, tall and broad, light-brown skin, white hair, a thick white mustache, a fine cream palm cowboy hat, a dark-grey western jacket over a white shirt, a silver belt buckle, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_PORTALSAHUAYO: Colonial arcade on the main plaza of Sahuayo, Michoacán, in the afternoon: a small hat stall under a stone arch with many woven palm cowboy hats hanging and stacked, bundles of dried palm, a wooden stool, a kiosk and trees in the plaza beyond, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
